question: Pin node #115's ObjectLibrary registry end-to-end: the Default getter 0x61f8b60, the registry count 0x61f8700, the unordered-map find-or-insert 0x5fd1da0 with its rehash 0x5fd1c60 and vector-insert 0x5fd17c0, the registration entry points insert 0x5fd24c0 / default-init 0x5fd20d0 / register 0x5fd27c0, the control-block teardown (D1/D0/_M_dispose/_M_destroy/_M_get_deleter) with the map destroy 0x5ff7820, the PatternEntry vtable and its matcher 0x61f8670 with the string matcher 0x61f8430 and per-element matcher 0x61f8280, and the FactoryEntry node vtables for Env and SystemClock. This answers the open unknown carried by PR #3948 about the role of the "Environment" string: every insert() registration lands under the single map key "Environment"; only default-init uses the map key "SystemClock".

fields.what: std::unordered_map {buckets, bucket_count, before_begin, element_count, max_load_factor, next_resize, single_bucket}

getter.role: ObjectLibrary::Default(): function-local-static singleton. Guard byte 0x6509108, holder at 0x6509110 (16 bytes: object ptr, control-block ptr); __cxa_guard_acquire/release; allocates a 0x10-byte holder and a 0x90-byte make_shared block; control-block vtable 0x64d00f0, packed counts 0x100000001 loaded from the global at 0x459b20; object at control+0x10. Fast path returns the holder address; callers dereference [0] for the object.

count.role: Locks the registry mutex (lock failure throws system_error); *out = map.element_count (registry+0x40); walks the before_begin chain summing (node+0x30 - node+0x28)/8 per node (value-vector lengths); unlocks; returns the total. So *out is the number of distinct map keys and the return is the total registered entries. After register() + default-init(): *out = 2, return = 3.

find_or_insert.role: _Hash_bytes(key.data, key.len, 0xc70f6907); bucket = hash % bucket_count; walks the bucket chain comparing stored hash, then key length, then memcmp; on a match returns &node+0x28 (the value vector); on a miss allocates a 0x48-byte node, move-constructs the key string into node+0x08, zeroes node+0x28..+0x40, calls _M_need_rehash and rehashes via 0x5fd1c60 if needed, links the node into the bucket (or before_begin if the bucket was empty), element_count++, stores the hash at node+0x40, returns &node+0x28. The cold FDE is the exception landing pad: it destroys the partially built node, the key string and the std::function at rsp+0x40, then _Unwind_Resume.

rehash.role: _Hashtable::_M_rehash_aux: allocates a new bucket array (count*8, memset 0), re-links every node by hash % new_count, frees the old buckets unless they were the single bucket.

vector_insert.role: std::vector<T*>::insert(vec, pos, &value) for 8-byte elements: size check vs max 0xfffffffffffffff (throw path at 0x5fd1956); growth doubling (new_cap = 2*size, overflow to max 0x7ffffffffffffff8); moves the value OUT of the source slot (the source is zeroed); shifts the tail; memcpy; frees the old buffer. Callers use it as push_back (pos = end).

insert.role: Clones the function (manager op 2 into a stack temp when the manager is non-null); allocates a 0x30-byte FactoryEntry node (vtable A 0x64cde68) and a 0x70-byte PatternEntry (vtable 0x64d8ed0); entry.pattern = key string; entry+0x28 = pattern length; entry+0x48 byte = 1; both vectors zeroed; entry+0x50 = 0; node = {vtable, entry*, std::function}. Locks the registry mutex; builds the key "Environment" (literal 0x44a397) and calls find-or-insert; appends the node* to the returned vector (fast path inline, slow path via vector-insert 0x5fd17c0); unlocks (tail-jump pthread_mutex_unlock on the fast path). After a successful vector-insert the moved-from source slot is null, so the trailing node-vtable-slot-1 dispatch is not reached on the success path — recorded as observed, dead on success.

default_init.role: Same node+entry construction INLINE (node vtable B 0x64cde98); pattern "TimeEmulatedSystemClock" (literal 0x4372ae), invoker 0x5fcd550 (mode-0) / manager 0x5fcc630; map key "SystemClock" (literal 0x438369); locks, find-or-insert, append (fast/slow paths as insert), unlock, calls count(registry, rsp+0x10), destroys temps, returns. Null-registry throws system_error(1); lock failure throws. Taken by address (lea at 0x5fd47c1) from the create host 0x5fd46c0..0x5fd4c2e as a pthread_once initializer with guard 0x6504b68, so it runs exactly once.

register.role: Calls the getter, registers TWO entries via insert 0x5fd24c0: pattern "MockEnv" (0x447686) with invoker 0x5fcd5b0 (mode-1) / manager 0x5fcc5d0, and pattern "CompositeEnv" (0x43e762) with invoker 0x5fcf450 / manager 0x5fcc600; then calls count(registry, rsp+0x08); destroys the empty temp string (literal 0x4376fd = ""); returns. Taken by address (lea at 0x5fd358e and 0x5fd3c3a) from two hosts (0x5fd34b0..0x5fd38f6 and 0x5fd39b0..0x5fd3cf6) as a pthread_once initializer with the shared guard 0x6504bb8, so it runs exactly once.

environment_key_answer.role: insert() hardcodes the map key "Environment". ALL entries registered through insert() live under the single map key "Environment"; the per-entry pattern strings ("MockEnv", "CompositeEnv", "SystemClock", "SliceTransform", ...) are stored in the PatternEntry objects, not as map keys. default-init is the exception: it uses the map key "SystemClock". After default-init + register, the map has 2 keys ("SystemClock", "Environment") and count returns 3 total entries with *out = 2. This answers the open unknown carried by PR #3948.

pattern_entry.vtable_boundary: The PatternEntry vtable has exactly 4 slots. The qwords that follow (0x64d8ef0 offset-to-top 0, 0x64d8ef8 typeinfo) are the header of the NEXT vtable in .data.rel.ro, the _Sp_counted_ptr_inplace<ObjectRegistry> control-block vtable at 0x64d8f00 (5 slots: D1 0x61f8130, D0 0x61f8140 delete 0xd0, _M_dispose 0x61f8760, _M_destroy 0x61f8170 delete 0xd0, _M_get_deleter 0x61f8180). Its dispose destroys a 0xc0-byte ObjectRegistry, a different class; it is recorded here as the boundary and is a follow-up work item, not part of this packet.

str_match.role: Empty +0x58 vector: exact match only (lengths equal and memcmp equal; the +0x48 flag is NOT checked). Equal lengths with a non-empty vector: exact match, and the +0x48 flag must be set. Otherwise the query must start with the pattern (query_len >= entry+0x50 + pattern_len; first min(query_len, pattern_len) bytes equal; query_len >= pattern_len), then every +0x58 element must match in sequence through elem-match 0x61f8280, and the tail decides by the last element's mode: mode 2 requires the position to reach the end of the query; modes 3/4 require the remainder (after an optional '-') to be digits / dotted digits with at least one digit; any other mode accepts.

elem_match.role: Returns the new position, or -1 on failure. Mode 2: the element string must occur AT pos; returns pos + len. Mode 0/1: std::string::find from pos+1, so the element may occur anywhere later; returns found + len. Mode 3: like 0/1, but the gap between pos and the found position (after an optional '-') must be all digits. Mode 4: like 3, but the gap may contain at most one '.' and must hold at least one digit. The mode governing element i+1 (and the tail after the last element) is stored in element i's +0x20 field; element 0 is governed by the initial mode 2.

open_unknowns: The ObjectRegistry class (0xc0-byte object; control-block vtable 0x64d8f00, dispose 0x61f8760, recursive destroy 0x61f81d0, string-dispose 0x61f814e) is a different class from ObjectLibrary; its functions are cited as the vtable boundary, not excerpted. A follow-up work item.
The _Sp_counted_ptr<Env*> control-block dispose (0x5fcc790), destroy (0x5fcc840) and get-deleter (0x5fcc7b0) are cited from RELATIVE records, not excerpted.

The mode field's lagged semantics (element i's +0x20 governs element i+1 and the tail) is recorded as observed; whether the source attaches the mode to the following segment or the parse assigns it that way is not established.
The two register hosts (0x5fd34b0..0x5fd38f6 and 0x5fd39b0..0x5fd3cf6) and the default-init host (0x5fd46c0..0x5fd4c2e) are identified by FDE range only; their names are not established.
The find-or-insert cold FDE (0x5fd1ffa..0x5fd20c4) shares code with another frame (the rsp+0xa8-canary portion); recorded as observed.
The registry's read-only find path (0x61c9d70) does not call find-or-insert in the census; its exact lookup shape is not pinned here.
The exact _Prime_rehash_policy prime selection is modelled from the libstdc++ policy as observed in find-or-insert's _M_need_rehash call; the rehash function itself (0x5fd1c60) is pinned exactly.
The hash function is libstdc++ _Hash_bytes with seed 0xc70f6907; the model substitutes a deterministic stand-in hash and pins placement/lookup, not hash values.
